name: print-social-green-launch-flyer-option-two-with-countdown-and-blob-badge
title: Launch Flyer Option Two with Countdown
whatItIs: A dark green presentation of three white flyer options with a row of colourful circles and semicircles along the top: the large Creatify Launch flyer with a green wordmark, a 04 days countdown flyer with a huge green numeral, and a 48 hours flyer with a red blob badge and the question 'Are you ready?', each with details bars in green and red.
whatItMeans: A row of geometric circles gives a joyful, African-pattern feel, and the huge countdown numbers add urgency.
techniques: Row of coloured circles and semicircles as a header
Giant green numerals for the countdown
Red blob badge with a clock icon
Green and red detail bars for place and time
Options shown on a dark green ground

vocabulary.definition: Posts counting down days or hours to an event.
A band of repeating shapes along an edge.
An organic shape holding a key message.
